name: Argus
description: A cute fluffy blue plush blob creature with a small leaf-shaped tuft on its head, black bead eyes and tiny stubby arms and feet, soft 3D felt render

poses.name: idle
poses.motion: breathes gently, blinks once, sways very slightly

poses.name: cheering
poses.motion: bounces up and down happily while waving both arms, the yellow sparkles twinkle

poses.name: curious
poses.motion: leans forward a little and looks around with interest, the tuft wobbles

poses.name: asleep
poses.motion: sleeps, body slowly rising and falling with each breath, the Z letters drift upward

poses.name: shocked
poses.motion: jolts with surprise, body trembling, the exclamation marks shake

poses.name: confused
poses.motion: tilts its head from side to side, puzzled, the question mark bobs

poses.name: sulking
poses.motion: keeps its back turned, huffs with a small shrug, the tuft twitches

poses.name: cool
poses.motion: nods slowly and confidently wearing its sunglasses

poses.name: love
poses.motion: hugs the red heart and sways side to side, the heart pulses gently

poses.name: rushing
poses.motion: runs in place in a hurry, feet pattering quickly, the speed lines flicker

poses.name: giggling
poses.motion: shakes with laughter, eyes squeezed shut, arms flapping, the sparkles twinkle

poses.name: scrolling
poses.motion: stares at the phone it is holding, thumbs tapping, the screen glow flickers

poses.name: peeking
poses.motion: peeks out shyly from behind the straight right edge, leaning out and back

poses.name: grumpy
poses.motion: frowns and stomps one foot, puffing up with a huff

poses.name: cozy
poses.motion: sways drowsily in its knit beanie, eyes closed, breathing slowly

poses.name: wink
poses.motion: rocks playfully and winks

poses.name: snacking
poses.motion: munches the cookie with small quick bites, cheeks moving

poses.name: dancing
poses.motion: dances, rocking side to side with a happy bounce

poses.name: hiding
poses.motion: trembles under its blanket and peeks out nervously

poses.name: idle_alt
poses.motion: breathes gently, blinks, looks left then right
